summary: Completed full backend + frontend test of AV Simulation portfolio. Backend: 9/9 pytest tests passed (root status, seed of 6 logs, admin verify good/bad, POST training-log auth enforcement, full CRUD + persistence, contact valid/invalid/missing email returning 422). Frontend: hero headline visible, iframe src exactly matches Eagle3D URL, 3 tech-spec cards with correct titles, archive-grid renders 6 video-card-* tiles from DB, contact form submission shows sonner success toast and clears fields, LinkedIn + email footer links correct. Admin: wrong passcode stays on login (401 toast), correct passcode 'paras-av-2026' loads CMS, new entry appears in admin-list and on landing archive (count 6 -> 7), delete via confirm dialog removes it (back to 6).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup' / 'shutdown'); newer versions warn — consider lifespan handlers in a follow-up.
GET /api/contact returns full list to anyone with admin passcode (header-only). Acceptable for personal portfolio but consider rate-limit on POST /api/contact to prevent spam.
Admin passcode is stored in plaintext in localStorage; fine for hobby project but flag as security note.
Default ADMIN_PASSCODE fallback inside source code ('paras-av-2026') duplicates the documented secret — moving the env-only would harden it.
seed_data_creation: Backend seeds 6 training logs automatically on startup; tests created and cleaned up TEST_ prefixed entries.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all endpoints with proper cleanup. UI fully tested via Playwright; iframe content is not validated (Eagle3D external stream), only the element/src. Sonner toasts appear as li[data-sonner-toast].
